text:
Plumber in Joondalup posts a hot water special on his Google profile.

Mobile number at the bottom. Facebook page for good measure.

Rejected.

Google can now remove posts with unverified phone numbers, emails or social handles.

Use the Call button. It's already there.

Google is the one place a customer tells you exactly what they want before you've said a word.

"Emergency electrician Osborne Park."

Job. Suburb. Urgency. Four words.

Nobody types that for fun.

Be the first name they see.

Young inexperienced George once wrote a client a 40-page marketing strategy.

Beautiful PDF. Charts and everything.

They read page one. (Generous estimate.)

Now it's one page. What we're doing this month and how we'll know it worked.

Nobody has ever asked for the other 39.
